title: Projectile Motion & Ballistics
description: Explore 2D projectile kinematics under various gravities, aerodynamic drag, and wind
notesPlaceholder: Record your observations, experimental results, hypotheses, and conclusions here...
h0_desc: Launch platform elevation above ground level

presets.moonDesc: Low 1.62 m/s² lunar gravity with zero atmosphere
presets.marsDesc: 3.72 m/s² Martian gravity with thin atmosphere

formulas.rangeExpl: Analytical relation for maximum horizontal distance in ideal vacuum conditions.
formulas.maxHeightExpl: Highest elevation attained above ground datum (where vy = 0).
formulas.flightTimeExpl: Total elapsed time from muzzle launch until impact with ground level.
formulas.dragExpl: Non-linear resistive force proportional to relative velocity squared.

steps.step1Title: Step 1: Launch in ideal vacuum at 45° angle
steps.step1Instr: Run the simulation in "Ideal" mode and compare the simulated horizontal range with the analytical theoretical value.
steps.step1Hint: In a vacuum with zero initial elevation, a 45° launch angle maximizes horizontal range.
steps.step2Instr: Switch physics mode to "Real" and launch again. Observe the percentage decrease in range.
steps.step2Hint: Aerodynamic drag continuously dissipates kinetic energy, distorting the parabolic trajectory.
steps.step3Title: Step 3: Launch from an elevated platform
steps.step3Instr: Increase platform height (h0) to 20 m. Does 45° remain the optimal launch angle?
steps.step3Hint: When the landing surface is lower than the launch point, the optimal range angle drops below 45°.
